production_metadata.production_description: Original Lean 4 proof of all six theorems of `coc_strong_normalization` (`typing_polyId`, `typing_polyId_app`, `step_polyId_app`, `subject_reduction`, `strong_normalization`, `consistency`) for CCω with impredicative `Prop` and predicative `Type 0, Type 1, ...` universes. Built in pure Lean 4 core (`ChallengeDeps` only, zero Mathlib imports) via Tait–Martin-Löf parallel reduction (`church_rosser`), Girard's reducibility candidates, and a `Type 0` Melliès–Werner finite-stage universe hierarchy with heterogeneous stage-equivalence relations. Verified across Lean default, Lean paranoid, lean4lean, con-leche, con-ron, and nanoda kernels with standard Lean axioms (`propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`) only.
